summary: Two threads lose updates on a shared counter.
true_fix: Guard the read-modify-write in `RequestCounter.record` with a `threading.Lock`, so the read of `total` and the write back are one atomic step.
nondeterminism_source: CPython switches threads every 5ms. A worker's loop spans several switch intervals, so two workers can read the same total and both write back the same incremented value, losing one update.
masking_fix: Run the workers sequentially, cut the iteration count until the interleaving stops happening, or relax the assertion to `<=`.
